messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** the freezing point of pure water is approximately **–2 °C**.  
This is slightly below the standard 0 °C freezing point at 1 atm (101.3 kPa). The exact value depends on the purity of the water and the precision of the measurement, but for most practical purposes –2 °C is a good estimate.
